chunks: And by this chain, from Ahmad ibn Idris from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from al-Husayn ibn Saeed al-Ahwazi from al-Husayn ibn Alwan from Abu Harun al-Abdi from Abu Saeed al-Khudri, in a long hadith of his—which we have summarized—he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to Fatima (peace be upon her): 'O my daughter, we, the People of the House, were given seven things that no one was given before us: Our prophet is the best of the prophets, and he is your father; our successor is the best of the successors, and he is your husband; our martyr is the best of the martyrs, and he is the uncle of your father, Hamzah; from us is one who has two green wings by which he flies in Paradise, and he is your cousin Ja'far; from us are the two scions of this Ummah, and they are your two sons, al-Hasan and al-Husayn; and from us is, by Allah, the One besides Whom there is no deity, the Mahdi of this Ummah, behind whom Isa ibn Maryam will pray.' Then he struck with his hand on the shoulder of al-Husayn (peace be upon him) and said three times: 'Who is this?'

key_terms.جَنَاحَانِ خُضيبَانِ: Two green wings (referring to Ja'far al-Sadiq)

ai.seo_question: What are the seven special gifts given to the Ahl al-Bayt according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* serves as a foundational proof for the Mahdi’s lineage from Imam Husayn, emphasizing the unique spiritual hierarchy of the Ahl al-Bayt through seven distinct honors. The Prophet’s triple gesture toward Husayn while mentioning the Mahdi underscores the direct ancestral link, a key point in Shia genealogical theology. It also highlights the eschatological role of the Mahdi, who will be followed by Prophet Jesus, reinforcing the continuity of divine guidance.
